summary: A current-source signed release APK updated in place on Pixel 7. App-only capture of Calculator again showed a fresh-looking Calculator thumbnail in the participant card while the large local self-preview remained black. The defect reproduces on versionCode 2025; remote playback was not tested.

checks.name: Release update installed without removing app data
checks.command: adb install -r app-release.apk; adb shell dumpsys package ru.boohtacord.app
checks.observation: The Pixel had versionCode 2024. The current-source 1.0.18/versionCode 2025 APK installed successfully over it with adb install -r; no uninstall or data clear was used.

checks.name: App-only Calculator capture and local self-preview
checks.device: Google Pixel 7, SHARE_TEST, microphone muted, no remote receiver
checks.command: Android screen-capture picker; adb exec-out screencap -p
checks.observation: Selected the Calculator task in Android's Show an app picker at the default 720p/15 FPS profile. After returning BOOHTACORD, the large local self-preview was fully black, while the participant card showed the Calculator keypad thumbnail. The system showed the active screen-share timer, and the room UI continued to report the microphone muted.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.command: Stop share, leave voice; adb shell dumpsys media_projection
checks.observation: The UI returned to the voice-room join screen and MediaProjection reported null; no projection remained active.

limitations: The room had no paired remote receiver, so web/macOS playback and receiver frame delivery were not tested.

The source/capture thumbnail and VideoTrackRenderer frame callbacks were not instrumented; the thumbnail demonstrates app-task pixels were available to that UI path but does not prove ongoing published-track frames.
This was a runtime reproduction only; no source fix was made and FE-59 remains open.
remaining: Instrument sender and local renderer frame flow, then repeat with a paired web/macOS receiver to isolate app-task capture, track publication, and Android rendering. Add a regression test and fix before closing T-030 preview acceptance.
